entries.title: Psalms 59:3
segments:
Not for my transgression; the opposition of the wicked to him was not caused by his sins against them. 
 
However numerous or mighty their enemies, God will protect his people, and eventually deliver them from all harm.

entries.title: Psalms 59:4
segments: They run; that is, run upon me as enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 59:5
segments: The heathen; the enemies of God and his people.

entries.title: Psalms 59:6
segments:
This verse, in the original, is the same as the fourteenth, word for word; and may, like it, be considered as either a prediction or a prayer. 
 
  Return; like hungry dogs that have taken no prey. 
 
  Make a noise; howl from hunger. 
 
  Go round about the city; in search of food.

entries.title: Psalms 59:7
segments: The wicked often flatter themselves that no one takes notice of their transgressions, or will call them to account for their sins.  But there is nothing covered that shall not be revealed, neither is there any thing hid, which is not seen, and shall not be made known.

entries.title: Psalms 59:9
segments: Because of his strength; because of the strength of my enemy who seeks my life.

entries.title: Psalms 59:10
segments: Prevent me; go before me and give me the victory over all my foes.

entries.title: Psalms 59:11
segments:
Slay them not; but preserve them in such a way as to be a warning to all others against continuing in sin. 
 
The condition of the wicked in this world is often a standing monument of their transgressions, and of the anger of God against them.

entries.title: Psalms 59:13
segments:
In Jacob; among his people. 
 
God ruleth in all places throughout the earth, and especially among his chosen people, and will cause all things to work for good to those who love him.
